title: Connection lost and cannot be reastablished on Unihertz Atom with Dexcom G5
symptom: Unihertz Atom connected to Dexcom G5, xdrip configured in OB1 native mode, runs perfect with 100% readings for hours until connection breaks, then xdrip cannot re-establish communication until smartphone reboot.
evidence_quote: xdrip can't establish the communication after that until the smartphone will be rebooted.
